final_message:
Nicknames now work: `createUser` accepts an optional `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it, or `null` when unset. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including both in `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

Changes:
- **`src/api/users.js`**: `createUser` stores `nickname ?? null`, and `getUser` returns `nickname` in its result.
- **`migrations/003_add_nickname.js`** (new): adds the `nickname` column to `users`. `Db.insert` rejects unknown columns, so the column has to exist before the value can be stored.

The migrations directory's README says it is owned by the DBA team. I added a new migration rather than editing `001` or `002`, which are already applied in production. Someone on that team should review `003` before it ships. I haven't committed anything.
